headings.text: Tax, books and advice for Lodi farms, wineries, businesses and families, all year long.
Lodi runs on harvest, crush and quarter end. Our work follows the same calendar.
Three kinds of clients, three different years. We learn yours before we give advice.
Three clients, three problems, and what changed once we fixed them.
Fourteen months of books in six weeks
Turn the wheel to any month and see what it asks of you, and what we do about it.
Third-quarter payroll return. We book your fall planning meeting.
